description: This file is a C++ header defining a mock class for the libusb API using Google Mock. It is used for testing purposes by simulating interactions with libusb without performing actual hardware communication.

classes.name: libUSBImplMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the libusb API interface for testing purposes, providing default behaviors for various libusb functions using Google Mock.

methods.description: Mock method for initializing a libusb context with options.
